name: Split-Flap Board
summary: Every metric is a row on a clattering departures board; one row flips to coral and holds until a human calls it.
look: A dark station board of mechanical flap tiles with a split hinge, off-white mono capitals and green ON TIME status flaps. Teal tiles carry the brand, coral tiles carry the anomaly and the CTA.

components.name: Flap cell
components.role: the single letterform: split top/bottom tile with a dark hinge

components.name: Board row
components.role: metric · value · status, laid out like a timetable

components.name: Status flaps
components.role: ON TIME in green, HELD in coral

components.name: Hero row
components.role: the anomaly promoted to large coral flaps with a glow

components.name: Ghost row
components.role: half-flipped blank tiles for depth and ambient motion

components.name: Action flaps
components.role: ROLL BACK and START FREE built from the same tiles in a lit frame

motion.name: Cascade flip
motion.how: top half rotateX 0→−90° power2.in 60 ms, bottom 90→0° power2.out 60 ms, 4–10 interim glyphs; one settle ≈ one beat at 120 BPM

motion.name: Row wave
motion.how: 30 ms stagger per cell, 120 ms between rows so a 3-row block lands in one bar

motion.name: Settle wobble
motion.how: final flap overshoots 4° with back.out(3) over 120 ms; the anomaly row wobbles twice and locks on the downbeat

story: Hook: a board of dashboards nobody looked at, '38 OPEN / 3 READ'. Reveal: the board cascades on the drop into the Acme mark tile, 'ACME' and a teal 'PULSE'. Proof: metric rows settle ON TIME while CHECKOUT keeps flipping, locks at −18% in coral with 'since 09:42 · after deploy #2231', and the cursor presses ROLL BACK. CTA: 'YOU SHIP. / PULSE / WATCHES.' row by row, then a coral START FREE flap button.
adapt: List your own objects (deploys, invoices, jobs, tickets) as rows of 9–10 characters and map your states to status words; let exactly one row switch to your alert color.

references.note: open-source split-flap display and flip mechanics

fit.risk: must feel mechanical even with the sound off; flip timing matters more than detail
